en: Fixed the Explore subagent switching to Opus on the Claude API when the session runs a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as a custom model behind a proxy; Explore now inherits that model
zh: 修复了当 session 运行 Claude Code 无法识别的模型 ID（例如代理后面的自定义模型）时，Explore subagent 在 Claude API 上切换到 Opus 的问题；Explore 现在会继承该模型
